description.value: Delitalia is a specialty Italian food shop in the Ocean Park neighbourhood of south Surrey, operating for over 25 years. Owners Penny and Romolo stock high-quality authentic Italian imports including charcuterie, deli items, groceries, and Italian beers, wines, and liqueurs. A touring cyclist passing through would find it a well-stocked stop for provisions and ready-made charcuterie platters.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for delitalia.ca loaded successfully and confirms the business identity, address (1629a – 128th Street, Surrey, BC), and phone (604-535-9588). The website describes a specialty Italian deli/grocery with products including deli, grocery, charcuterie platters, gift baskets, and Italian wines/beers/liqueurs, confirming the Groceries category. No bike parking, water, or cycle-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website or OSM tags, so all cycle criteria are null. A notable discrepancy exists: OSM assigns the community as Tsawwassen, but the website explicitly places the business in the Ocean Park neighbourhood of south Surrey.
concerns: OSM assigns the community as Tsawwassen, but the website explicitly states the business is in the Ocean Park neighbourhood of south Surrey — the OSM community tag appears incorrect.
OSM has no phone number; 604-535-9588 was sourced from the website only.
OSM opening_hours tag contains an apparent formatting anomaly for Monday ('Mo 11:00-17:00,09:00-18:00') that does not match the website's stated Monday hours.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An established 25-year-old specialty Italian deli and grocery with confirmed hours and active website; useful provisioning stop for touring cyclists in the south Surrey/Ocean Park corridor.
